verses.text: Then the LORD said to Moses,
"Look, I have chosen Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, from the tribe of Judah.
I have filled him with the Spirit of God. I have given him wisdom, understanding, and knowledge, and skill in all kinds of work.
He can make beautiful designs and work with gold, silver, and bronze.
He can cut and set precious stones, carve wood, and do every kind of skilled work.
And I have chosen Oholiab son of Ahisamach, from the tribe of Dan, to help him. I have also given skill to all the skilled workers, so that they can make everything I have commanded you:
the Tent of Meeting, the ark of the covenant with its cover, and all the other furniture of the tent,
the table and its tools, the pure gold lampstand and all its tools, the altar of incense,
the altar of burnt offering and all its tools, the washing bowl and its stand,
the woven clothes, both the holy clothes for Aaron the priest and the clothes for his sons when they serve as priests,
and the anointing oil and the sweet-smelling incense for the Holy Place. They must make them just as I have commanded you."
Then the LORD said to Moses,
"Tell the people of Israel, 'You must keep my Sabbaths. This is a sign between me and you for all generations to come, so that you will know that I am the LORD, who makes you holy.
Keep the Sabbath, because it is holy to you. Anyone who treats it as unholy must be put to death. Anyone who does any work on that day must be cut off from his people.
For six days work may be done, but the seventh day is a Sabbath of complete rest, holy to the LORD. Anyone who does any work on the Sabbath day must be put to death.
The people of Israel must keep the Sabbath, celebrating it for all generations to come, as a covenant that lasts forever.
It will be a sign between me and the people of Israel forever. For in six days the LORD made the heavens and the earth, and on the seventh day he stopped working and rested.'"
When the LORD had finished speaking to Moses on Mount Sinai, he gave him the two tablets of the covenant, the stone tablets written by the finger of God.
